certification.name: Certified Third Party Risk Assessor
certification.description: Certification for assessors of third-party IT risk controls, requiring five years of related experience and attendance at a live bootcamp. The remotely proctored exam has 120 multiple-choice scenario questions and a 70% pass mark.
certification.currency_note: Exam is bundled with the live CTPRA bootcamp; the public page could not be opened and indexed prices conflict. Annual maintenance fee $100
